description.zh: 米尔福德峡湾是新西兰峡湾国家公园的核心景观，被鲁德亚德·吉卜林誉为「世界第八大奇迹」。垂直峭壁从海面直插云端，米特峰高达1,692米，雨后百瀑悬挂，气势磅礴。
description.en: Milford Sound — Rudyard Kipling's 'Eighth Wonder of the World' — is the centrepiece of Fiordland NP. Sheer cliffs plunge from 1,692 m Mitre Peak straight into the sea; after rain, hundreds of waterfalls appear.

description.zh: 霍比特村是彼得·杰克逊《指环王》和《霍比特人》系列电影的拍摄地，位于新西兰北岛的马塔马塔农场。44座圆门霍比特洞穴和「绿龙酒馆」让影迷得以亲历中土世界。
description.en: Hobbiton is the filming location for Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings and Hobbit trilogies, set on a Matamata farm on New Zealand's North Island. Its 44 hobbit holes and the Green Dragon Inn bring Middle-earth to life.

location.zh: 怀卡托大区马塔马塔，新西兰北岛
location.en: Matamata, Waikato, North Island, New Zealand

description.zh: 皇后镇被誉为「世界探险之都」，是蹦极跳、跳伞、喷射快艇、滑雪等极限运动的发源地或集中地。瓦卡蒂普湖畔依山傍水的小镇风光与壮阔的雪山景观相互映衬，四季皆宜。
description.en: Queenstown is the 'Adventure Capital of the World' — the birthplace of commercial bungee jumping and a hub for skydiving, jet-boating and skiing. Set on Lake Wakatipu beneath snowy peaks, it is superb year-round.

location.zh: 奥塔哥大区，新西兰南岛
location.en: Otago region, South Island, New Zealand

description.zh: 海湾群岛位于新西兰北岛最北端，由144座岛屿组成，是帆船、海豚共游、钓鱼和深潜的天堂。怀唐伊条约签署地——怀唐伊Treaty Grounds也位于此处，是新西兰最重要的历史遗址。
description.en: The Bay of Islands comprises 144 islands at the tip of New Zealand's North Island — paradise for sailing, swimming with dolphins, fishing and diving. Waitangi Treaty Grounds, NZ's most important historic site, stands here.

location.en: Northland region, North Island, New Zealand
